item.title: Karoline Leavitt resigns after Trump kept calling her on maternity leave, reports say
item.description: News outlets reveal the president repeatedly contacted the White House press secretary asking when she would return to work. We’re in the midst of a mass exodus of working mothers from the workforce. The latest to join is Karoline Leavitt, White House press secretary, who resigned from her post Wednesday. And it might have been because President Donald Trump had been calling her while she was away on maternity leave, reports suggest....
